value.name: mother studies Asha's face
value.description: Asha's mother looks over her face with slow, searching attention, as if trying to recognize her.
evidence: her mother's eyes moved over her face with the slow, searching attention of someone reading a page in poor light.
she watched the eyes move over her face again, slower this time, snagging at her hairline and then her mouth

value.name: Rosa hesitates in doorway
value.description: Rosa stays in the doorway, observing the tense silence between Asha and her mother without intervening.
evidence: From the doorway Rosa held her step back
From the doorway Rosa kept her place
she did not step forward to ease any of it

value.name: Asha grips her mother's hand
value.description: Asha tightens her hand around her mother's, seeking a response from fingers that do not fully close back.
evidence: Asha tightened her hand around her mother's, just enough to feel the answering weight of fingers that did not quite close back

value.name: Asha leans closer to her mother
value.description: Asha leans in close to her mother, staying near her instead of pressing for an answer.
evidence: leaned in until the lamp on the dresser threw a soft edge along her mother's cheek
she only stayed where she was, close enough

value.name: Asha waits for recognition
value.description: Asha decides not to hurry her mother's recognition, accepting that it must come in its own time.
evidence: Whatever recognition was going to come was going to take its own time
Asha ... found she could do nothing to hurry it

value.name: Asha speaks old name softly
value.description: Asha softly calls her mother's childhood name for her, the private name no one else has ever used.
evidence: she said the old name softly, the one her mother had used when she was small enough to fit under one arm, the one no one else in the world had ever used for her
